title: Grateful Dead Live at  on 1986-03-31
source: Recording Info: (FOB) Schoeps -> PCM -> Dat Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> SHN Patch Info:Nakamichi 300/CP4 -> Master Cassette (Marantz PMD430) -> CD (Tascam CDRW5000) -> EAC -> Cool Edit Pro v1.2 -> SHN (Taped By Jon Pasternak) via Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Decent source with crisp Phil bass, solid but cut‑short show highlighted by a good Johnny B. Goode.
ai_review.review: The recording is considered an improvement over other available versions, with Phil Lesh’s bass described as ‘crispy.’ The concert itself was a solid, 70's‑flavored performance that ended abruptly after a beer bottle was thrown into Billy’s kick drum, but it still delivered a respectable rendition of Johnny B. Goode and several enjoyable cover tunes.

ai_rating.rationale: Three moderate (3‑star) reviews note an improved but not exceptional recording and a solid yet interrupted show, yielding an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls this version a 'better recording' than the other one available and highlights Phil Lesh's bass as crisp; no specific issues with hiss, dropout, or balance are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show had a solid, 70's feel with good cover tunes but was cut short after a beer bottle struck the drummer's kick, ending the performance prematurely.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass comes in crispy; praised for clarity.
band_member_comments.Drums: Show ended early when a beer bottle was thrown into Billy's kicker, causing frustration among the audience and band.
